description: 经典科技 - 冷色边界与青蓝强调，结构理性、代码感明确，适合工程 / 教程 / 开发内容

styles.body: font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #0f172a; line-height: 1.82; letter-spacing: 0.2px; padding: 14px 12px; background: #ffffff;
styles.h1: font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.36; margin: 32px 0 18px; padding-bottom: 11px; color: #111827; font-weight: 800; border-bottom: 3px solid #0ea5e9;
styles.h2: font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.45; margin: 32px 0 16px; color: #111827; font-weight: 750; border-bottom: 2px solid #0ea5e9; padding-bottom: 6px;
styles.h3: font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 25px 0 11px; color: #0f172a; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
styles.blockquote: margin: 22px 0; padding: 16px 18px; color: #164e63; background: #ecfeff; border: 1px solid #bae6fd; border-left: 3px solid #0ea5e9; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.78;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 6px; margin: 22px auto; display: block; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(14,165,233,0.08);
styles.code_inline: font-family: Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.92em; background: #eef2ff; color: #1e3a8a; padding: 0.1em 0.34em; border-radius: 4px;
styles.code_block: margin: 1em 0; padding: 1em; background: #0f172a; color: #dbeafe; border-radius: 8px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.58;
styles.li_bullet: display: inline-block; min-width: 16px; margin-right: 8px; color: #0ea5e9; font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 900;
styles.li_number: display: inline-block; min-width: 34px; margin-right: 9px; color: #0369a1; font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 22px 0; font-size: 13.5px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; table-layout: fixed; word-break: break-word;
styles.th: border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; padding: 9px 10px; background: #f0f9ff; color: #075985; text-align: left; font-weight: 700;
styles.td: border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; padding: 9px 10px; color: #1e293b; vertical-align: top; line-height: 1.6;
styles.caption: font-size: 12.5px; color: #7a7f87; text-align: center; margin-top: 9px; line-height: 1.6;
styles.section_divider: text-align: center; color: #0ea5e9; letter-spacing: 6px; font-size: 11px; margin: 34px 0; user-select: none; font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; opacity: 0.75;

list_style.label: 终端方括号序号
list_style.num_container: display: inline-block; min-width: 34px; margin-right: 9px; color: #0369a1; font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800;
list_style.bullet_container: display: inline-block; min-width: 16px; margin-right: 8px; color: #0ea5e9; font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 900;
